page.overview:
What is Force deflection?

In 232 BBY, during the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Porter Engle fought a pair of Nihil on Elphrona when a party of the raiders attempted to kidnap the wealthy Blythe family for ransom. During the skirmish, Engle temporarily parted with his lightsaber when he threw it to eliminate one of the raiders. Before he could retrieve his weapon, the other raider fired at him, forcing Engle to deflect the shots with the Force.

In 40 BBY, Qui-Gon Jinn contemplated employing this power, but ultimately rejected the idea as too hard, for plasma responded poorly to being commanded by the Force.

In 22 BBY, Jedi Grand Master Yoda confronted his former Padawan learner Dooku, secretly the Sith Lord Darth Tyranus, in a hangar on Geonosis during the First Battle of Geonosis. Tyranus, who had previously defeated Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, exclaimed his superiority over his former Master and fired a blast of Force lightning at Yoda. Yoda deflected the blast back at Tyranus, who in turn used the Force to deflect the blast into the ceiling of the hangar. The Jedi Master then absorbed another bolt of the Sith's lightning into his body without any harm, prompting Dooku to turn to his lightsaber for combat.

In 19 BBY, Yoda also was able to deflect melee attacks.
